name: Nonosaki Tsubasa
source:
Nonosaki Tsubasa is your other sister, who has always been in her older sister’s shadows. She is also in love with you, but by the beginning of the game, the two of you haven’t progressed past the siblings stage. She is cheerful and hard working despite being clumsy and a fantastic actress, being a member of the drama club. However, acting is pretty much her ONLY talent.

[From [url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2009/08/28/moshimo-ashita-ga-harenaraba-review/]Calamitous Intent's review[/url]]
